newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Barclays Bank chief says won't sell BZW.
newsitem.headline: Barclays Bank chief says won't sell BZW.

text.p: Barclays Bank Chairman Andrew Buxton said on Tuesday his bank had no intention of hiving off its investment banking arm BZW.
"There is no substance in these rumours," Buxton told Reuters when asked about persistent reports that Barclays was considering selling BZW.
"We are actually investing in BZW at the moment, as you may have seen from our accounts in 1996, and we are continuing that investment in 1997.
"That investment is already showing some results, so we have no intention of hiving off BZW.
"These are media-inspired rumours. They are not true," he added.
Buxton said Barclays Bank management had repeatedly denied any interest in selling BZW, but no one seemed to take any notice.
Buxton said no high-level study group had been set up by Barclays to look at hiving off BZW.
"That is simply not true. This is pure blue skies speculation in the media," he said.
